verdicts.item: Story & side: all story missions / 10 Stranger strands / 5 bounties / 25 random encounters / 1 gang ambush / 6 gang hideouts
verdicts.appSays: All story missions (optional can be skipped), 10 strangers, Bounties 5, Random encounters 25, Gang ambush 1, Gang hideouts 6 (Thieves Landing and Fort Mercer are Epilogue)
verdicts.evidence: Both PowerPyx and the wiki list any 10 stranger strands, any 5 bounties, 25 chance/random encounters, one survived gang ambush (Bushwhacked) and 6 hideouts. PowerPyx says 4 hideouts clear automatically in the story and the last two (Thieves Landing, Fort Mercer, New Austin) are only reachable after Arthur's story. It also says the story row ticks once the Epilogue is finished, so skipped optional missions do not matter.

verdicts.item: Collectibles: point of interest 1, graves, 1 cigarette card set, dinosaur bones, legendary fish, exotics, rock carvings, hunting requests 5, 1 treasure chain, dreamcatchers
verdicts.appSays: POI 1; graves (9); one full card set (12 cards); 30 bones; 13 legendary fish; all exotics; 10 rock carvings; hunting requests 5 (Ms. Hobbs); 1 treasure map chain; 20 dreamcatchers
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx: any 1 POI, 9 graves, one cigarette card set (12, not all 144), 30 bones, 13 legendary fish, all Algernon exotics, 10 carvings, all hunting requests (5 for Ms. Hobbs, the last only from Epilogue Part 1), 1 treasure chain, 20 dreamcatchers. The wiki phrases the strands as completing A Test of Faith, A Fisher of Fish, Duchesses and Other Animals, Geology for Beginners and A Better World, A New Friend (the hunting-request strand), plus 1 card set, 1 treasure chain and 20 dreamcatchers.

verdicts.appSays: Animals 50, Equipment 10, Fish 10, Gangs 6, Horse breeds 10, Plants 20, Weapons 48
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx gives the same numbers (50 of 178 animals, 10 of 72 equipment, 10 of 30 fish, 6 gangs, 10 of 19 horses, 20 of 43 plants, 48 of 59 weapons), and so does the wiki.

verdicts.item: Player: Health/Stamina/Dead Eye level 10, bonding 4, 90 challenges
verdicts.appSays: Health, Stamina and Dead Eye at level 10 (howTo calls it "cores' level"), horse bonding 4, all 90 challenges (9 x 10)
verdicts.evidence: The wiki and PowerPyx both require level 10 attributes, bonding level 4 and all 90 challenges (9 categories of 10). The wiki notes normal play only gets the attributes to 8, and the last two levels need extra items. One wording problem: the requirement is the attribute level, not the core level. Cores are the separate inner rings.
verdicts.fix: In the Best in the West howTo, change "cores' level (10)" to 'attribute level 10 (Health, Stamina, Dead Eye)'.

verdicts.item: Misc: shacks 5, legendary animals 5, table games, ranters 5, bath, show, Theatre Raleur, 6 recipe types, 4 robberies
verdicts.appSays: 5 shacks, 5 legendary animals, each table game once, 5 ranters/ravers, bath, show, Theatre Raleur show, one of each of 6 recipe types, coach/home/shop/train robbery
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx: 5 shacks, 5 of 14 legendary animals, 1 game each of Poker, Blackjack, Dominoes and Five Finger Fillet, 5 ranters/ravers/campaigners, 1 hotel bath, 1 show (e.g. Valentine magic lantern), 1 Theatre Raleur show in Saint Denis, 6 recipe types (cooking, tonic, ammo, hunting item, horse care item, weapon), and coach, home, shop and train robberies. The wiki lists the same items (5 special characters, craft from six categories, the same four robberies). Nothing is missing. Cosmetic only: the in-game name is written with accents (Theatre Raleur with accented e and a).

verdicts.appSays: goal 38 categories
verdicts.evidence: The 38 rows add up correctly (6 + 10 + 7 + 15). But the in-game Total Completion screen does not group things this way: the four robberies are one requirement, and the 3 attributes are one. So 38 is the app's own row count, not an in-game number.
verdicts.fix: If any text implies the game shows 38 categories, reword it to say 38 checklist rows.

verdicts.appSays: 35 names and descriptions as in the extract
verdicts.evidence: All 35 descriptions match the PowerPyx trophy list and the wiki table (without trailing periods), including 'Complete one of the Collectable strands', 'Attain 100% completion', 'Take From the Rich' (capital F), 'It was THIS Big!' and 'Self Sufficient' (no hyphen). The one exception is below.

verdicts.item: Grin and Bear it - trophy name capitalisation
verdicts.appSays: Grin and Bear It
verdicts.evidence: The official name uses a lower-case 'it'. PowerPyx (trophy list and guide), the wiki table, and the PlayStationTrophies, TrueTrophies and Exophase listing titles all write 'Grin and Bear it'.
verdicts.fix: Rename to 'Grin and Bear it' (lower-case i) in the trophy entry and grind label.

verdicts.item: Legend of the West description / requirement
verdicts.appSays: 'Unlock all other trophies.'; earn 34 other single-player + 17 Red Dead Online trophies
verdicts.evidence: The wiki lists 34 other single-player trophies plus 17 Red Dead Online trophies (Breakout ... Notorious), which makes 51 plus the platinum. That matches PowerPyx's total of 52. The description is the standard platinum wording. The wiki paraphrases it and does not quote it exactly.

verdicts.appSays: $250 robbed or looted
verdicts.evidence: The description says to rob or loot $250. PowerPyx says it builds up over time from looting bodies during the story.

verdicts.appSays: $5000 across shops
verdicts.evidence: The description says to spend $5000 across all shops. PowerPyx suggests saving first and reloading afterwards.

verdicts.item: Grin and Bear it - 18 attacks, kill method, bear species
verdicts.appSays: 18 attacks; let bear knock you down, escape, shoot it from the ground during the prompt; spot between Wallace Station and Watson's Cabin
verdicts.evidence: The count of 18 and the method are confirmed: PowerPyx says to let the bear grab you, break free, and kill it while you are still on the ground. Kills made any other way do not count. PowerPyx also recommends the spot between Wallace Station and Watson's Cabin. On species, PowerPyx and GamerGuides do not limit it to one kind of bear, but one search-indexed guide (PSTrophies/TrueTrophies) says only grizzlies count and black bears don't. The app's spot is a grizzly spawn, which covers either reading.
verdicts.fix: Optional: add 'use grizzlies - some guides report black bear kills not counting'.

verdicts.appSays: 30 unique items (30 different recipes, not 30 crafts)
verdicts.evidence: The description requires 30 unique items in Story Mode. PowerPyx explains that recipes come from the story, fences and cooked meats.

verdicts.item: Bountiful - $250 in all 5 states for 3 days, New Austin during story
verdicts.appSays: 5 state checkboxes incl. New Austin; howTo says New Austin already carries a story bounty
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx says Arthur has a $250 New Austin bounty automatically until the Epilogue, so during the story you only need 4 states. After the story you also have to raise one in New Austin. TrueAchievements and PSTrophies snippets say the same (the Blackwater bounty stays maxed until the Epilogue). The bounty lasts until you pay it at a post office.
verdicts.fix: Clarify: 'During Arthur's chapters New Austin already counts - only 4 states to raise. In the Epilogue you must raise New Austin yourself.'

verdicts.appSays: Bonding level 4 with a horse
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx says level 4 is the maximum bonding level and unlocks the trophy. The wiki's 100% list also uses bonding level 4.

verdicts.appSays: No restriction mentioned (grind check 'maximum (or minimum) Honor reached'; howTo: save, then go low or high)
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx says the trophy cannot unlock until a Chapter 5 main mission is done. It calls the mission 'Paradise Mercifully Escaped', but no mission has that name: the Chapter 5 mission is 'Paradise Mercifully Departed', as listed in PowerPyx's own walkthrough and gold medal pages. TrueTrophies/TrueAchievements snippets carry the same restriction (with the same wrong name). PowerPyx adds that Chapter 6 is the first realistic chance, since Honor changes are 50% bigger there. The research claim is right, but the app doesn't tell the player. If they grind Honor earlier, the trophy won't pop.
verdicts.fix: Add to howTo and grind label: 'Cannot unlock before completing the Chapter 5 mission "Paradise Mercifully Departed". Best done in Chapter 6 (Honor gains/losses +50%) or after the story.'

verdicts.appSays: Description correct; howTo: 'Buy every component option (e.g. for the Cattleman: grip, barrel, rifling, sights)'
verdicts.evidence: The description matches. But PowerPyx says to change each component slot once, not buy every option; its example is the Double-Action Revolver with grip, barrel length, barrel rifling and iron sights. The app's 'buy every component option' makes players think they must buy every variant in each slot, which costs more than needed.
verdicts.fix: Reword to 'Change every component slot once (e.g. grip, barrel length, barrel rifling, sights)'. Either use PowerPyx's Double-Action Revolver example or check that the Cattleman has the same slots.

verdicts.appSays: Poker, Blackjack, Dominoes, Five Finger Fillet; just join, no need to win
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx says there are exactly 4 minigames for this trophy and you only need to sit down briefly. The 100% table-games row lists the same four. Horseshoes and arm wrestling are not part of it (they are Red Dead Redemption 1 minigames).

verdicts.appSays: 16 lb (7.3 kg) fish; legendary fish guarantee it
verdicts.evidence: The description matches. PowerPyx says it unlocks naturally while catching the 13 legendary fish.

verdicts.appSays: 70 gold medals; 34 spare
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx: 70 of 104 gold medals are required, which leaves 34 spare.

verdicts.appSays: 5 hunting requests; last only after Epilogue Part 1; Ms. Hobbs east of Strawberry
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx: all 5 requests for Ms. Hobbs; the last one only opens in Epilogue Part 1; she then invites you to her hut at the top right of Strawberry. The wiki's 100% list requires the matching strand, A Better World, A New Friend.

verdicts.appSays: After the story, 9 graves; Hosea+Lenny together
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx says there are 9 graves (Hosea and Lenny share a spot, so 8 sites) and they only appear after finishing the story. The wiki's 100% page also says graves are only available after story completion, and the wiki shows 8 location maps. The wiki's trophy page is inconsistent: it lists graves opening after individual missions (Arthur and Susan after the Epilogue mission Simple Pleasures). Advising post-story is the safe choice. The wiki adds that Hosea's and Lenny's headstones must each be interacted with.
verdicts.fix: Optional: add 'interact with Hosea's and Lenny's headstones separately'.

verdicts.appSays: Kieran: field east of Braithwaite Manor; Susan: cliff over railroad near Emerald Station; Arthur: east of Bacchus Station; Jenny: near Glacier/Spider Gorge; Eagle Flies: west side Donner Falls; Sean: hill by Flat Iron Lake NW of Rhodes; Davey: Colter
verdicts.evidence: Sean, Davey, Eagle Flies, Jenny and Hosea/Lenny match the wiki and PowerPyx. The other three use different landmarks from the sources: Kieran is in a meadow west of Shady Belle and south of Bolger Glade; Susan is on a hill above the railroad south-west of Elysian Pool; Arthur is on a hilltop south-east of the Mysterious Hill Home in Grizzlies East. The app's landmarks are roughly in the same places but are not the ones the sources use.
verdicts.fix: Use the source landmarks: Kieran 'meadow west of Shady Belle / south of Bolger Glade'; Susan 'hill over the railroad SW of Elysian Pool'; Arthur 'hilltop SE of the Mysterious Hill Home (Grizzlies East)'.
